title: CoreWeave founders have sold $2.3B in stock since the company's lockup period expired in August after a March 2025 IPO, reducing their combined holdings by ~25% (Ella Feldman/Bloomberg)
summary: Ella Feldman / Bloomberg: CoreWeave founders have sold $2.3B in stock since the company's lockup period expired in August after a March 2025 IPO, reducing their combined holdings by ~25% — CoreWeave Inc.'s stock price has more than doubled since the AI data center operator's March 2025 initial public offering.
